content:
A few StrongPNT updates from me:

  1. I noticed that when Borel-Caratheodory was upstreamed the hypothesis on the real part was needlessly made into a strict inequality. I've opened #35914 to fix that so that we can eventually depend on the Mathlib version.
  2. I've just opened PNT#1076 to simplify @Preston T's proof of LogOfAnalytic. There's already a Mathlib result to get primitives of analytic functions so no need to work directly with the path integral representation of it.
  3. Now seems like a good chance to mention that I have a fork of the original AI generated StrongPNT proof: https://github.com/ajirving/strongpnt. I've updated it to v4.28.0 and made it depend on more of the results in the PNT project. It's still unreasonably long but getting shorter all the time. Given how much AI generated code we're now accepting into the project I think we might eventually want to just accept some version of this StrongPNT proof. In the meantime I'll keep tidying it when I have time and motivation.
